text.tspan: Female labor force participation rate 1890 to 2025
Share of the female working-age population (ages 15 and over) who are economically active (employed or
unemployed). Figures refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable across countries and over

tspan.tspan: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026); Killingsworth and Heckman (1986)
For some observations prior to 1960, the participation rate is calculated with respect to the female population aged 14+.
